unit.why: An anecdote: the Maggid of Kozienice's young grandson overhears a private talk between the Maggid and the Holy Jew, retells all of it, and amazes the Holy Jew.

stories.start_quote: ואמר כי מאוד חשקה נפשו לנסוע
stories.summary_en: The Holy Jew asks the Maggid of Kozienice to send him his grandson, but the Maggid refuses. When the boy overhears their secret conversation and repeats all of it, the Holy Jew praises the child to the Maggid, who replies that he knew this long ago.
